system.story: The holy warrior - the second front-liner, and the only ministry that carries Judgment.

description.value:
Subclass: Templar (the smiter / frontline lean - and the Judgment order). The holy warrior, the most durable of the three ministries.

Role Feature - Judgment

Bonus to smiting damage and frontline durability (higher Stamina than the other ministries, better melee/forced-movement). Judgment (a Presence-based mark, Templar-only): mark one enemy as anathema - while marked it takes holy/corruption damage or a bane when it acts within line of effect, and the first time each round you damage or are damaged by the marked foe you bank bonus Conviction, tying the mark into the resource engine.

Signature Pact-Summon

An angelic/infernal warrior - a combatant.

Corp Records

Militant-order asset.
